logisticsBlock.title: Shipping Terms Explained
logisticsBlock.body: EXW: you arrange pickup from our factory. CIF: we ship to your port; you handle customs and duties. DDP: freight, customs, duties and delivery are quoted to your address. Tell us your city and whether you have a customs broker, and we will recommend the right route.

extraModule.title: Need slab only?
extraModule.body: If your installer is reusing existing jambs, we can review door slabs without jamb or hardware. Specify slab size and handing.

faq.q: Does the price include jamb, hinges and lockset?
faq.a: A complete prehung set can include the slab, jamb, hinges and lockset preparation. The final scope and quotation are confirmed from your door schedule and hardware requirements.

faq.q: Can you match my finished wall thickness?
faq.a: Yes. Send the finished wall thickness for each opening so the jamb depth can be reviewed with the schedule.
Yes. If you are reusing existing jambs, send the slab size and handing for review.

faq.q: How many sets fit in a 40HQ container?
faq.a: {{SETS_PER_40HQ}}. The final capacity depends on approved leaf sizes, jamb scope and packaging configuration.

faq.q: What do you need from me to quote?
faq.a: Send the quantity, door sizes, finished wall thickness, jamb scope, finish, hardware preparation, handing and destination.
